recipe_version.title: Roasted Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese
recipe_version.description: Silky soup of oven-roasted Roma tomatoes, onion, and garlic blended with vegetable broth, basil, and a splash of cream, served with golden, buttery sharp-cheddar grilled cheese on sourdough for dunking.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp for roasting, up to 1/2 tsp to finish

ingredients.name: vegetable broth
ingredients.note: vegetable broth keeps the meal vegetarian

ingredients.name: fresh basil
ingredients.note: loosely packed leaves; save a few small leaves to finish

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.note: milk allergen; reserve 1 tbsp to swirl on top

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: only if the tomatoes taste sharp

ingredients.name: sourdough bread
ingredients.note: about 1/2 inch thick, from a plain (unseeded) sandwich-size loaf. Wheat allergen.

ingredients.name: sharp cheddar
ingredients.note: block, about 2 cups shredded. REQUIRED vegetarian cheddar: label states microbial or non-animal rennet (or vegetarian). Milk allergen.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: for the outside of the bread. Milk allergen.

steps.title: Heat the oven and prep the tomatoes
steps.body: Heat the oven to 450 F with a rack in the upper-middle position at the start of prep; it preheats while you work. Core and halve the tomatoes lengthwise, cut the onion into 8 wedges, and peel the garlic. On a rimmed sheet pan, toss the tomatoes, onion, and garlic with the olive oil, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and the pepper, then turn the tomatoes cut side up. Shred the cheddar and leave the butter out to soften.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.body: Roast until the tomatoes slump and blister with browned, caramelized edges, the onion tips char, and the garlic is soft, 25 to 28 minutes.

steps.title: Build the sandwiches
steps.body: While the tomatoes roast, butter one side of each bread slice. Make 4 sandwiches with the buttered sides out and about 1/2 cup cheddar inside each, pressing gently so they hold together.

steps.title: Simmer the soup
steps.body: Scrape the roasted vegetables and every bit of their juices into a large pot. Add the tomato paste, vegetable broth, and basil leaves (keep a few small leaves for the top). Bring to a simmer over medium-high, about 4 minutes, then simmer gently 6 minutes. Turn the oven off.

steps.title: Griddle the grilled cheese
steps.body: As soon as the soup goes on, heat a 12-inch skillet over medium-low. Cook 2 sandwiches at a time until the bread is deep golden and crisp and the cheese has melted, 3 to 4 minutes per side, pressing lightly with a spatula. Keep the first batch on a rack in the turned-off, still-warm oven while you cook the second.

steps.title: Blend and finish
steps.body: Take the soup off the heat and blend with an immersion blender until silky, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in all but 1 tbsp of the cream. Taste; add up to 1/2 tsp salt, and the sugar only if the soup tastes sharp. Rewarm briefly without boiling.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Ladle the soup into bowls, swirl the reserved cream on top, and add the reserved basil leaves. Cut each grilled cheese in half diagonally and serve alongside for dunking. kitchen_tested is false.
